title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2610.32874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. translated_title: “真”与“假”相加等于一吗？LLM智能体观点模拟中的互补一致性
translated_abstract: 在LLM智能体观点模拟中，每个智能体在看到自己之前的概率以及邻居所报告的概率后，报告某条声明为真的概率，该数字将成为它在下一轮中的状态。如果这个数字描述的是智能体的立场而非它所看到的句子本身，那么将该声明改写为其否定形式，并把每个概率p替换为1-p，理应得到互补的答案，即两次报告之和应为1。我们使用三个小型开源模型（Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B和Gemma-3-4B）对此进行了测试。在从一次运行中的网络模拟提取的2,304个智能体状态上，Qwen的成对报告之和平均为1.18；而在来自AVeriTeC的48条真实事实核查声明上，其结果同样超过1。一个包含24个双结果世界（每个世界恰好有两种可能结局）的受控基准测试表明，三个模型都存在同样的失效现象。这一偏差比相同均值扰动所引起的变化大两到十倍。
tldr: 该研究首次系统揭示了LLM智能体在观点模拟中违反互补一致性——对同一命题及其否定所报告的概率之和超过1（如Qwen3-4B平均达1.18），且该偏差远大于扰动噪声两到十倍，意味着此类模拟结果可能存在系统性扭曲。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a complement consistency failure in LLM-agent opinion simulations: across Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Gemma-3-4B, the probabilities reported for a claim and its negation sum to more than one (averaging 1.18), with discrepancies two to ten times larger than perturbation effects, suggesting such simulations may be systematically biased.
